notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

First hotfix for Bokeh Adventure to fix a few small issues!

-Fixed an unobtainable Pinky in Level 5-3

-Fixed an unobtainable Costume in Level 5-2

-Teleports can no longer be exploited

-Fixed a bug where earning a lower photographer badge after already achieving a higher photographer badge would overwrite the higher one

-Fixed the activation of the 'Nothing Left to Prove!' achievement
